```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full-height separator and combine the panels cell by cell:
    # a cell is marked only when both corresponding panel cells are nonzero.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 1 for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [
        [2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
         for c in range(min(len(left[r]), len(right[r])))]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
```
